enchantment.nl.double_jump.desc: Press the jump key again while airborne to leap a second time.
enchantment.nl.sluggish.desc: Your strikes can bog the target down in a viscous haze.
enchantment.nl.bleeding.desc: Your strikes can open wounds that keep hurting.
enchantment.nl.staggering.desc: Your strikes can briefly knock the target off balance.
enchantment.nl.executioner.desc: Strikes against weakened targets hit harder — and you can see when they are vulnerable.
enchantment.nl.predator.desc: Strike back harder at the enemy that just hit you.
enchantment.nl.momentum.desc: Chained kills keep you fast — taking a hit breaks the flow.
enchantment.nl.echo.desc: A part of your strike sometimes repeats a moment later.
enchantment.nl.mark.desc: Your first hit marks a target; keeping the pressure rewarded.
enchantment.nl.hawkeye.desc: Fully-drawn shots fly harder and truer.
enchantment.nl.ricochet.desc: A missed arrow springs once toward a nearby enemy.
enchantment.nl.recall.desc: Arrows sometimes return to your quiver after landing.
enchantment.nl.shadowstep.desc: When struck, you may slip backward leaving a shadow of yourself behind.
enchantment.nl.climber.desc: Sprint to climb ladders and vines faster; jump to leap off them.
enchantment.nl.shatter.desc: Your picks sometimes crack the neighboring blocks of the same family.
enchantment.nl.prospector.desc: Mining ore sends out a pulse — diamonds nearby make it sing.
enchantment.nl.green_thumb.desc: Harvesting sometimes spreads a burst of growth around you.
enchantment.nl.reaping.desc: Harvesting sometimes sweeps the neighboring crops in one go.
enchantment.nl.grounded.desc: You stand firm — a share of knockback slides off you.
enchantment.nl.reprisal.desc: Blows against you sometimes bite back at the attacker.
enchantment.nl.second_wind.desc: At the brink, a burst of vigor carries you a little longer.
enchantment.nl.tenacity.desc: Weathering blow after blow hardens you against the next ones.
enchantment.nl.sentinel.desc: Your helm quietly stirs when hostile eyes watch you.
enchantment.nl.wayfarer.desc: Long stretches of honest travel reward you with a moment of vigor.
enchantment.nl.resonance.desc: Attuned pieces hum together, slowly knitting your wounds.
enchantment.nl.voidbound.desc: Once, when death should have taken you, the void refuses to collect.
enchantment.nl.reflection.desc: Airborne steel turns against its archer.
enchantment.nl.soulbond.desc: Each bonded piece refuses to leave you — up to three times.
